context.label: GitHub Actions benchmark comparison
context.precision: Parsed from generated SVG tooltip labels at their exported precision. Raw harness result rows are archived; individual timed samples and confidence intervals are not retained.
context.notes: One full make bench-compare execution on a shared CI runner with 4 available vCPUs. The 8/16-worker cases oversubscribe those CPUs. Results are not a controlled comparison with the earlier Ryzen measurements.
context.compilerNote: The recorded Go launcher is 1.23.1. The module requires 1.25.0 and GOTOOLCHAIN=auto was enabled; the effective Go compiler was not captured. The unmodified generated report records the launcher version.
